spanish: Anduvo el pueblo y recogieron, y molieron en los molinos o machacaron en el mortero, y cocieron en la olla, y lo hicieron tortas; y era su sabor como sabor de fresco de aceite.

findings.issue: Qal perfect 3cp is singular Anduvo, agreeing with singular pueblo; later verbs stay plural. Same participants; collective agreement smoothing.
Anarthrous dual millstones rendered as definite plural los molinos, which can be read as several mills rather than the dual instrument.
Construct noun rendered as fresco, one point in an open range (moisture, juice, freshness), not a second concept beyond the token.
Definite הַשָּׁמֶן rendered as indefinite aceite.

notes: Construct order taste–לשד–oil, the או alternative, 3ms אתו, and plural עגות are preserved.
